name: zombie_rider.live_light_memory_continuity_mcw
description: Native rider light-memory continuity: one current exposed furniture lamp is sampled by one loaded rider, creates finite source-keyed memory and an investigation intent, then stops refreshing and expires after native source removal.

steps.label: post_load_rider_light_memory_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: staged hostile rider and exposed lamp load to live map

steps.label: audit_saved_midnight_mature_before_rider_light_memory
steps.abort_reason: installed save did not prove mature-world midnight footing

steps.label: audit_saved_clear_weather_before_rider_light_memory
steps.abort_reason: isolated fixture did not prove deterministic non-portal weather footing

steps.label: audit_saved_rider_light_memory_footing
steps.abort_reason: saved active_monsters did not prove the tagged hostile rider

steps.label: audit_saved_exposed_powered_lamp_before_rider_light_memory
steps.abort_reason: saved-map metadata did not prove exactly the exposed powered utility-lamp furniture source

steps.label: operate_native_rider_light_memory
steps.objective: Use only advertised native World actions. Confirm the powered exposed utility light is emitting, advance native turns until the loaded rider receives the current physical lamp sample, bash the source through the production-native switch-off path, and stop while the finite source-keyed memory and investigation intent are still active so native save/reload can test their persistence.
invariants: no fire, smoke, sound or player-target substitution
no direct memory or destination mutation

steps.label: confirm_native_process_replacement_after_rider_save
steps.objective: Use the advertised native save-and-quit path, then the native Main-menu Quit action and confirmation, while the saved rider memory remains active.

evidence_contract.claim: one source-bound native rider samples an exposed physical lamp, acts through its owning source-keyed light memory, stops refreshing after native source loss and expires that memory
evidence_contract.setup_guard: fixture setup earns no behavior credit
evidence_contract.writeback_note: global rider light memory is persisted by the overmap save contract; native save/reload is required if the route reaches a nonempty memory

steps.label: audit_relaunched_first_observation_rider_light_memory
steps.abort_reason: first replacement observation did not preserve the exact active rider memory sample/source/expiry

steps.label: audit_relaunched_active_rider_light_memory
steps.abort_reason: saved replacement world did not preserve the active rider memory

steps.label: advance_relaunched_rider_memory_past_expiry
steps.expected_visible_fact: receipt-backed native wait crosses the rider memory expiry window
